name: fix_django_exclude_filter_bug
description: Fixes an inverted queryset filter returning exactly the wrong rows
prompts: active_products() in shop/services.py is documented to return the products that are NOT discontinued, but its filter is inverted - it returns exactly the discontinued ones. Fix shop/services.py so it returns only products with discontinued=False, still ordered by name. Products with zero stock are still active as long as they aren't discontinued - don't filter on stock.

from django.db import models


class Product(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    discontinued = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    stock = models.IntegerField(default=0)

test_setup_files.test_active.py:
import os, django
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'settings')
django.setup()
from django.core.management import call_command
call_command('migrate', run_syncdb=True, verbosity=0)
from shop.models import Product
from shop.services import active_products

Product.objects.create(name='anvil', discontinued=False, stock=0)
Product.objects.create(name='hammer', discontinued=False, stock=7)
Product.objects.create(name='whale-oil', discontinued=True, stock=3)

names = [p.name for p in active_products()]
assert names == ['anvil', 'hammer'], f'active_products wrong (zero-stock anvil must be included): {names}'
print('PASS')
